shigley.note: Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design, chapter 8 solutions: bolted joints in shear. Member bearing sigma = F / (n d t); tension of members on the net section across the holes in one cross-section.

sources.aisc_360: ANSI/AISC 360-16 J3.10: tear-out strength of a bolt hole Rn = 1.2 lc t Fu (lc = clear distance from the hole edge to the free edge). That is two shear planes of length lc at 0.6 Fu, so at P = Rn the tear-out shear on those planes is 0.6 Fu.

aisc_tearout.note: lc = 38 - 22/2 = 27 mm; Rn = 1.2 * 27 * 10 * 450 = 145.8 kN; tear-out shear at P = Rn must be 0.6 Fu = 270 MPa

limit_notes: Inch problems converted at 4.448222 N/lbf and 25.4 mm/in; the printed stresses are 3 to 4 figures.
